settings.database.lockFolderHint: This folder is where the application records which record is currently being edited. The name has to start with a dot, because that is exactly how the application recognises that a folder does not belong in the index, the search and the statistics. The change applies to everyone working in this area.

settings.database.lockFolderError.nurPun: A name made up only of dots does not denote a folder. Something has to follow the dot.
settings.database.lockFolderError.pfadTr: The name must not contain a slash. The folder always sits directly in the root folder of the area.
settings.database.lockFolderError.verbot: The name contains a character that is not allowed in a folder name. Not allowed are < > : | ? * as well as the straight quotation mark and invisible control characters.
settings.database.lockFolderError.endeUn: The name must not end with a dot or a space. Windows silently strips both when creating the folder.
settings.database.lockFolderError.lockFo: The root folder of the area already contains a folder or a file with this name.
